results.title: AI and Optical Data Sciences VII, Conference Details
results.content: I will then highlight advances in AI and automation for photonic design, including physical AI-based Maxwell solvers, fabrication-aware inverse design framework, MAPS, and scalable inverse training algorithm of meta-optical neural networks. We present a unified photonic processing platform that, based on III-V semiconductors, combines linear circuit reconfigurability with programmable nonlinear optical functions, enabling compact, adaptive optical computing. These diffractive processors designed by deep learning have various applications, e.g., all-optical image analysis, feature detection, object classification, computational imaging and seeing through diffusers, also enabling task-specific camera designs and new optical components for spatial, spectral and temporal beam shaping and spatially-controlled wavelength division multiplexing. We demonstrate the efficiency of linear programmable photonic neural networks for low-power optical computing applications. By generating hypervectors with over 100,000 dimensions through optical scattering and integrating them with holographic memory-based computing, we achieve significant improvements in latency and energy consumption compared to electronic and photonic neural networks.

results.title: What is State Succession? Types and Legal Implications ...
results.content: What is state succession? State succession is a significant concept in international law. ## **Meaning of State Succession** State succession occurs when one state legally replaces another in its international obligations and relations. There are various reasons why state succession happens: Each form of change affects how laws, treaties, and diplomatic rights transfer from one state to another. ## **Different Kinds of State Succession** There are several recognized forms of state succession under international law. All successor states are considered new entities under international law. ## **Legal Consequences of State Succession** * **Treaty obligations:** Whether the new state continues with existing treaties. ## **International Law on State Succession** ## **Challenges in State Succession**
